title: Resource Exhaustion: File Descriptor Limit Reached in API Gateway
description: API Gateway hit the OS file descriptor limit (ulimit -n 65536) due to a connection leak in the HTTP client pool. Connections to upstream services not closed on error paths. Gateway starts rejecting connections with 'too many open files'.
initial_symptoms: API Gateway returning '500: too many open files'
Gateway process file descriptor count at 65536 (limit)

evidence_catalog.summary: API Gateway open file descriptors grew from 10k to 65536 (limit) over 30 minutes
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT open_fds FROM process_metrics WHERE service='api-gateway'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate process FD metrics

evidence_catalog.summary: Gateway logs: 'accept4: too many open files' and 'dial tcp: too many open files'
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE service='api-gateway' AND message LIKE '%too many open files%'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate 'too many open files' logs

evidence_catalog.summary: Gateway v1.2.0 deployed at 11:30 with new HTTP client pool config
Commit changed HTTP client: increased pool size but removed connection close on error
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will create commit with HTTP client changes

evidence_catalog.summary: Upstream HTTP client errors increased 10x at 12:00 (connection failures leak FDs)
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT client_errors FROM http_client_metrics WHERE service='api-gateway'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate upstream error metrics

changes.summary: API Gateway v1.2.0 deployed with HTTP client connection leak

causal_chain.from_description: Deployment v1.2.0 removed connection close on HTTP client error path
causal_chain.to_description: Failed upstream connections leak file descriptors; FD count grows to OS limit

causal_chain.from_description: FD count reaches 65536 (ulimit -n), new connections fail
causal_chain.to_description: 'too many open files' errors; gateway cannot accept new connections
Complete API outage for all downstream services

contributing_factors: HTTP client pool max size > FD limit
Error path not tested for resource cleanup
Default ulimit too low for high-traffic gateway

must_not_claim: Upstream service outage caused FD leak

misleading_or_confounding_signals: Upstream service errors increased (but they're the trigger for the leak, not the root cause)
Gateway CPU normal (FD exhaustion doesn't show in CPU)

required_checks.description: Check process open file descriptor count
Review HTTP client error handling for connection close

remediation_guidance.suggestion: Fix HTTP client to close connections on error; increase ulimit; add FD usage alerting
test_plan: Fix connection cleanup in error path
Add FD usage alert at 80% limit
remediation_guidance.rollback_plan: Rollback to gateway v1.1.5; increase ulimit immediately
